claims.claim: In a study of more than 120,000 older adults, patients taking nitrogen-containing bisphosphonates were up to 24 percent less likely to develop dementia.
claims.episode_span: patients taking nitrogen-containing bisphosphonates were significantly less likely to develop Alzheimer's disease and other dementias, by as much as 24 percent
claims.source_title: Common osteoporosis drugs linked to 24% lower dementia risk in major study
claims.supporting_quote: In a study involving more than 120,000 older adults, researchers at the University of Hong Kong (HKUMed) found that patients taking certain medications to strengthen their bones were significantly less likely to develop dementia.

claims.claim: The bisphosphonate dementia study was published in Alzheimer's & Dementia and conducted by HKUMed researchers.
claims.episode_span: researchers at the University of Hong Kong found that patients taking nitrogen-containing bisphosphonates were significantly less likely to develop Alzheimer's disease and other dementias, by as much as 24 percent, and published the work in Alzheimer's & Dementia
claims.source_title: Common osteoporosis drugs linked to 24% lower dementia risk in major study
claims.supporting_quote: The research, conducted by scientists in the Department of Pharmacology and Pharmacy at HKUMed's LKS Faculty of Medicine, was published in Alzheimer's & Dementia .

claims.claim: More than 55 million people live with dementia, projected to reach 139 million by 2050.
claims.episode_span: More than 55 million people worldwide live with dementia, a figure the authors say is projected to reach 139 million by 2050
claims.source_title: Common osteoporosis drugs linked to 24% lower dementia risk in major study
claims.supporting_quote: More than 55 million people worldwide currently live with dementia, and that number is projected to climb to 139 million by 2050.

claims.claim: The same HKUMed team previously found osteoporosis and fractures are independent risk factors for dementia.
claims.episode_span: The same team had already reported that osteoporosis and fractures are independent risk factors for dementia
claims.source_title: Common osteoporosis drugs linked to 24% lower dementia risk in major study
claims.supporting_quote: Previous research by the same HKUMed team established that osteoporosis and fractures are independent risk factors for dementia.

claims.claim: In an analysis of nearly 200,000 adults 65 and older, a high-dose flu vaccine was associated with a nearly 55 percent lower Alzheimer's risk, versus 40 percent for the standard dose.
claims.episode_span: people who received a high-dose influenza vaccine had a nearly 55 percent lower risk of developing Alzheimer's, compared with a 40 percent reduction previously associated with the standard-dose vaccine
claims.source_title: Stronger flu shot linked to nearly 55% lower Alzheimer's risk
claims.supporting_quote: Researchers at UTHealth Houston analyzed nearly 200,000 adults ages 65 and older and found that those who received a high-dose influenza vaccine had a nearly 55% lower risk of developing Alzheimer's, compared with a 40% reduction previously associated with the standard-dose vaccine.

claims.claim: The FDA warned that GLP-1 drugs carry a potential risk of NAION and required companies to inform patients and doctors.
claims.episode_span: the Food and Drug Administration warned that GLP-1 drugs carry a potential risk of non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy
claims.source_title: Pharmalittle: We're reading about an approval for novel drug for strokes, a warning for GLP-1 drugs, and more
claims.supporting_quote: The FDA warned that GLP-1 drugs carry a potential risk for a rare but serious eye condition and required pharmaceutical companies to inform patients and doctors of the risk , STAT writes.

claims.claim: The FDA began examining the GLP-1 eye risk after a 2024 observational study linked Ozempic and Wegovy to NAION.
claims.episode_span: The agency said it began looking after a 2024 observational study linked Ozempic and Wegovy to the condition.
claims.source_title: Pharmalittle: We're reading about an approval for novel drug for strokes, a warning for GLP-1 drugs, and more
claims.supporting_quote: The FDA said it started looking into this risk after researchers in 2024 published an observational study linking Ozempic and Wegovy to the eye condition.

claims.claim: NAION is caused by insufficient blood flow to the optic nerve, can cause sudden vision loss and blindness, and has no proven treatments.
claims.episode_span: The condition is caused by insufficient blood flow to the optic nerve, typically causes sudden vision loss, and in severe cases can lead to blindness
claims.source_title: Pharmalittle: We're reading about an approval for novel drug for strokes, a warning for GLP-1 drugs, and more
claims.supporting_quote: The condition, called non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy, or NAION, is sometimes referred to as an “eye stroke” and is caused by insufficient blood flow to the optic nerve.

claims.claim: Georgetown researchers used population-based simulation modeling, reported in JAMA Network Open, to estimate chemotherapy's effect on biological aging in breast cancer survivors.
claims.episode_span: In a population-based simulation, not a trial that assigned an anti-aging treatment, researchers at Georgetown University's Lombardi Comprehensive Cancer Center estimated the lifetime balance of curing breast cancer against possible acceleration of biological aging
claims.source_title: Chemotherapy for breast cancer linked to accelerated biological aging
claims.supporting_quote: This research is the first to estimate the lifetime balance of the benefits of curing breast cancer versus possible acceleration of biological aging using population-based simulation modeling.

claims.claim: Female breast cancer survivors are the largest segment of 18.6 million U.S. cancer survivors, according to Jeanne Mandelblatt.
claims.episode_span: Senior author Jeanne Mandelblatt said female breast cancer survivors are the largest segment of the 18.6 million cancer survivors in the United States
claims.source_title: Chemotherapy for breast cancer linked to accelerated biological aging
claims.supporting_quote: Female breast cancer survivors comprise the single largest segment of the 18.6 million cancer survivors in the United States.

claims.claim: The chemotherapy model accounts for more senescent cells that secrete inflammatory molecules.
claims.episode_span: increasing senescent cells that have stopped dividing, resist cell death, and secrete molecules that add tissue damage and inflammation
claims.source_title: Chemotherapy for breast cancer linked to accelerated biological aging
claims.supporting_quote: This affects many aging systems, including increasing the number of senescent cells, which are damaged cells that have stopped dividing and are also resistant to cell death,

claims.claim: Rentosertib, a TNIK inhibitor from In Silico Medicine, was in a phase 2 trial for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and proteomic aging clocks were reported to move younger.
claims.episode_span: In human data from a phase 2 trial of the TNIK inhibitor rentosertib for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, researchers report that multiple proteomic aging clocks moved younger
claims.source_title: Anti-Fibrotic Drug Rentosertib Reduces Proteomic Clock Age in Humans
claims.supporting_quote: Rentosertib is a TNIK inhibitor developed by In Silico Medicine in the course of the company's efforts to find drugs that can affect aging, shown to be anti-fibrotic, and thus recently in a phase 2 trial for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

claims.claim: A Nature Aging paper using patient brain samples and mouse models identifies mitovesicles and Ggt1 in Alzheimer's pathology.
claims.episode_span: In patient brain samples and mouse models, Li, Xia, Sun, Jia and colleagues report a pathological role for mitovesicles in Alzheimer's disease, and identify Ggt1
claims.source_title: Mitochondria-derived extracellular vesicles mediate Alzheimer’s disease pathology through transmitting microglial Ggt1
claims.supporting_quote: Li, Xia, Sun, Jia et al. identify a pathological role for mitovesicles in Alzheimer’s disease using patient brain samples and mouse models.

claims.claim: A review in Aging Cell concluded that poor sleep and inflammaging worsen each other.
claims.episode_span: scientists publishing in Aging Cell concluded that poor sleep quality and inflammaging worsen each other
claims.source_title: Inflammaging and Poor Sleep Contribute to One Another
claims.supporting_quote: After a review of substantial literature, scientists publishing in Aging Cell have concluded that poor sleep quality and inflammaging worsen each other in a vicious

claims.claim: Glymphatic cerebrospinal fluid drainage declines with age and in Alzheimer's and clears amyloid-β, α-synuclein, tau, and TDP-43.
claims.episode_span: cerebrospinal fluid drainage, including the glymphatic system, as declining with age and especially in Alzheimer's, with a role in clearing amyloid-β, α-synuclein, tau, and TDP-43
claims.source_title: Evidence for Cerebrospinal Fluid Flow Through the Brain to Stagnate in Alzheimer's Disease
claims.supporting_quote: Measure of glymphatic drainage decline with age, and are particularly negatively impacted in patients with Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative conditions.

claims.claim: A reported study found NAD blood levels do not fall with age.
claims.episode_span: A study reported by Nutraceutical Business Review found that NAD levels in blood do not fall with age
claims.source_title: NAD blood levels don’t fall with age, study finds, challenging longevity claims
claims.supporting_quote: NAD blood levels don’t fall with age, study finds, challenging longevity claims

claims.claim: Cepharanthine was identified as a novel senolytic candidate among low-cost plant extracts.
claims.episode_span: Fight Aging! reports cepharanthine, a plant extract, as a newly identified senolytic candidate
claims.source_title: Cepharanthine Identified as a Novel Senolytic
claims.supporting_quote: Interesting new approaches emerge a few times every year, some of which are low cost supplements and plant extracts, such as the candidate noted here.

claims.claim: CALERIE randomized 218 nonobese adults aged 21 to 51 to a two-year intervention designed for 25 percent caloric restriction or an ad libitum diet; the restriction group achieved 11.7 percent restriction and 10.4 percent weight loss.
claims.episode_span: Investigators randomized 218 nonobese adults aged 21 to 51 years, average body mass index 25.1, either to an intervention designed to reach 25 percent restriction or to an ad libitum diet.
claims.source_title: A 2-Year Randomized Controlled Trial of Human Caloric Restriction: Feasibility and Effects on Predictors of Health Span and Longevity
claims.supporting_quote: To determine CR's feasibility, safety, and effects on predictors of longevity, disease risk factors, and quality of life in nonobese humans aged 21-51 years, 218 persons were randomized to a 2-year intervention designed to achieve 25% CR or to AL diet.

claims.claim: In CALERIE, resting metabolic rate residual fell more with restriction at 12 months but not 24 months, core temperature barely differed, and T3 fell more at both time points.
claims.episode_span: Resting metabolic rate adjusted for weight change fell more with restriction at 12 months, but not at 24 months.
claims.source_title: A 2-Year Randomized Controlled Trial of Human Caloric Restriction
claims.supporting_quote: RMR residual decreased significantly more in CR than AL at 12 months (p = .04) but not 24 months (M24). Core temperature change differed little between groups. T3 decreased more in CR at M12 and M24

claims.claim: In 18 rhesus monkeys on 30 percent caloric restriction versus 18 controls, muscle gene expression shifted toward metabolism and away from immune and matrix pathways.
claims.episode_span: Eighteen animals on 30 percent restriction were compared with 18 controls.
claims.source_title: Caloric restriction reprograms skeletal muscle molecular pathways in non-human primates
claims.supporting_quote: In this cross-sectional study, we investigated skeletal muscle gene expression changes induced by 30% CR in skeletal muscle in rhesus monkeys (n = 18 CR, n = 18 control).

claims.claim: In human astrocytes, 2-deoxyglucose reduced inflammatory gene expression and metabolic flux after interleukin-1β stimulation.
claims.episode_span: 2-deoxyglucose reduced oxygen consumption and extracellular acidification in the presence of the inflammatory signal, and lowered expression of the pro-inflammatory genes TNF, IL-6, and C3
claims.source_title: Caloric restriction mimetic 2-deoxyglucose alters metabolic and transcriptomic phenotype in association with changes in chromatin accessibility in human astrocytes
claims.supporting_quote: 2-DG reduced oxygen consumption rate and extracellular acidification rate in the presence of IL-1β, while concomitantly decreasing expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF, IL-6, and C3.

claims.claim: A 2007 review modeled a 2.8-year life-expectancy gain if a 48-year-old man maintained 30 percent caloric restriction until age 78, based on animal patterns.
claims.episode_span: A model in that paper suggested that a 48-year-old man who held 30 percent restriction until an expected death at 78 might gain 2.8 years of life expectancy.
claims.source_title: Starving for life: what animal studies can and cannot tell us about the use of caloric restriction to prolong human lifespan
claims.supporting_quote: Modeling these impacts suggests that if a 48-y-old man engaged in 30% CR until his normal life expectancy of 78, he might increase his life expectancy by 2.8 y.

claims.claim: A 2012 review calls caloric restriction the most potent environmental intervention that delays aging and extends lifespan in diverse experimental organisms.
claims.episode_span: A 2012 review in the American Journal of Human Biology calls it the most potent environmental intervention known to delay the onset of aging and extend life in diverse experimental organisms.
claims.source_title: The caloric restriction paradigm: implications for healthy human aging
claims.supporting_quote: Caloric restriction (CR) has emerged as a model of major interest as it is widely agreed that CR is the most potent environmental intervention that delays the onset of aging and extends life span in diverse experimental organisms.

claims.claim: A 2013 review defines caloric restriction as at least 10 percent below ad libitum intake in humans and says animal and limited human evidence points to effects on blood pressure, lipids, and inflammation.
claims.episode_span: energy intake well below ad libitum, at least 10 percent in humans and at least 20 percent in animals
claims.source_title: Caloric restriction: implications for human cardiometabolic health
claims.supporting_quote: Evidence from animal studies and a limited number of human trials indicates that calorie restriction has the potential to both delay cardiac aging and help prevent atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease via beneficial effects on blood pressure, lipids, inflammatory processes, and potentially other mechanisms.
